cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. You never did take to my lesson about letting things go. Perhaps this is what we needed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still want to put the certificate back inside the cup. Your degree's safe. Let the broken handle teach you something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Applying the lesson to the teacher. Take it; I'll learn to mean what I say. Show me which jam jar to drink from tomorrow.
